title: 48 requests pull toward five themes
description: every rim node = a feature request · lines bundle into the theme that claimed it

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered request IDs and their caller-assigned theme IDs. Unique nonempty request IDs are required. An unknown or missing theme retains its request on the rim without inventing a connection.

props.name: themes
props.description: Unique theme IDs, caller labels and finite angular positions in degrees. Hub area encodes the count of requests actually assigned to each theme; zero-count themes retain labels without a hub.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
